summary: The implementation successfully addresses most PWA requirements including manifest configuration, service worker with offline support, iOS meta tags, navigation patterns, install prompts, lazy loading, and responsive design. However, background sync for offline mutations (REQ-2) appears to have only placeholder implementation, and image optimization specifics (REQ-6) are not explicitly evident in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Background sync for data mutations when offline - user actions made offline should be queued and sync when connection restored
missing_requirements.reason: Service worker includes a sync event listener and syncMessages function, but it only contains placeholder comments stating 'Implementation depends on IndexedDB storage of offline actions' without actual queuing/syncing logic for user mutations

missing_requirements.requirement: Image optimization with properly compressed images and responsive formats
missing_requirements.reason: While lazy loading is implemented via React.lazy() and code splitting, there is no evidence in the diff of image compression, responsive image formats (WebP, AVIF), or responsive image loading techniques (srcset, picture elements)
